assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Unspecified atrial fibrillation is coded I48.91
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
The service is intended to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the context of the patient's known atherosclerotic heart disease and atrial fibrillation
